scope: One bounded development_train input handoff; no model or Fit execution
portable_layout: Materialize module files in a directory with a pinned local project at ../laya-tools; Root may author a private modfile instead. No module download or implicit absolute replacement is included.
external_pins: Root separately freezes exact plan_sha256, root_admission_sha256 and data_sha256 in the invocation. Embedded claims and matching pins are byte bindings, not proofs of Root evidence/readiness. Root must create/review this new schema admission plan before execution.
plan_rules: All fields required; exact case-sensitive decoded JSON keys, duplicates/extra/missing/null containers, malformed UTF-8 and surrogate escapes fail.

Plan candidates preserve selected order, ID/text/label/unit weight; source_index preserves prior ordinal independently of selected index. Selected supervision must be known; positive requires all_required_known_true and zero unknown predicates; known negative requires known_counterexample and can retain unknown_predicates.
Excluded unknown source candidates require explicit null label/weight plus reason. Full source ordinal coverage and unique IDs are verified; U never becomes a negative or zero-weight selected row.
Root truth known requires one or more selected positives. Root truth no_answer must be explicit and requires no positives; never inferred from all-negative data.

Sorted sparse group roles and lexically sorted family roles join by search, independent of parent count. Same group/family conflicting roles fail; historical roles can appear in registry only. New JSONL rows remain development_train because unchanged Reader supports that role only.

Source revision, text revision, scope and feature policy are exact Root plan fields. Per-row SHA includes exactly one terminal LF; whole data SHA pins row order and prefix if Root preserves previous pins. The bridge does not independently certify a previous corpus prefix or source genealogy.
failure_contract: Invalid plan/authority pins keep Reader0 and consumer0.
Data hash mismatch keeps Reader0 and consumer0. Later row mismatch can have completed Reader calls, but consumer remains0.
ReaderReturned includes error returns; raw Reader/consumer diagnostics are never formatted. Consumer is attempted only once after all rows pass; its error is fixed diagnostic, no retry.
No file I/O paths are opened, no outputs or durable checkpoints are created. Consumer panic is not recovered. Root later supplies durable wrapper/resource limits, not this source module.
feature_separation: Batch.Input returns only unchanged shortclaim.ValidatedInput. Metadata/supervision/source ordinals have separate value accessors. Batch.Parent copies the pinned supervision into claimfit.Parent without Project/Features/Fit. Prepared metadata IDs remain present in the DTO but unchanged Project uses request/caption text only; any future consumer must preserve that boundary.
synthetic_control_source: variable row counts 1/7/33/60 and selected counts2/3
case aliases/duplicate/missing fields and invalid surrogate rejection
per-row exact text/metadata/raw SHA/order and extra-line rejection
U-only exclusion plus known-negative-and-U metadata preservation
explicit Root no_answer vs inferred all-negative rejection
one consumer error return and independent value snapshots
